# Branding slot

Put your NYU torch image here as `nyu-torch.png` (a PNG with a transparent background, roughly square). The Commencement title card shows it at the top centre, where the torch sits on a real NYU diploma. Until the file exists the space stays empty. The game never draws the torch or any other logo itself.

The icons in this folder (`favicon.svg`, `favicon-32.png`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`) are original: a blackletter C on aged paper in a violet mat.
